answer_1.quote: Image captioning is one of the key visual-linguistic tasks that asks for generated captions with specific images... we evaluate on Microsoft COCO, Flickr8K, COMPOSITE and PASCAL-50S datasets.
answer_1.outputs: Metric scores for generated captions and correlation values with human judgments.

answer_2.quote: We use common standard metrics in our scoring tasks, such as BLEU-1, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SPICE. We also use the original BERTScore to check the improvement of our metrics.

answer_3.quote: We choose BERT (base) and RoBERTa (large) as the pre-trained language models, extract contextual embeddings and compute recall scores with a mismatch threshold.
methods: contextual embedding similarity with threshold-based mismatch detection

answer_4.quote: In 2015 COCO Captioning Challenge, submissions are evaluated by human judgments with five kinds of metrics: M1... M5... Flickr 8K provides Expert Annotation scores... PASCAL-50S uses AMT workers to choose which sentence is more similar to the reference.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rate captions using metrics M1–M5 (better/equal to human, Turing test, correctness, detail, similarity) and expert scores (1–4) or pairwise preference judgments.
